name: IC Power Switching Regulator — 5V, boost — SOT
description: This cluster contains SMD 5V boost IC switching regulators in SOT package family footprints such as SOT-363_SC-70-6.
selection_hints: Select when requiring a 5V boost switching regulator IC in a SOT footprint.
Use when designing for surface-mount (SMD) assembly with SOT-363_SC-70-6 footprint requirements.
Verify tier A status and footprint compatibility for LTC3525-5 or related symbols.
avoid_when: Do not use if the design requires a package family other than SOT.
Avoid when non-boost topologies or output voltages other than 5V are needed.
Avoid if through-hole mounting is required instead of SMD.
